The Verse of the Elder Dhammapāla:
“Indeed, that young bhikkhu who applies himself to the Buddha’s teaching...”
He is indeed awake among those who sleep;
his life is not in vain.
With serene confidence and vision of the Dhamma,
the wise person should devote themselves to it,
remembering the teaching of the Buddhas.
